revision.title: ETH Daily Security: Getting Ethereum Users to the Tools That Protect Them
revision.summary: Ethereum security builders ship good tools, and most users never hear about them. ETH Daily is moving from a general news briefing to a dedicated security publication, and uses its existing audience to send users to anti-phishing tools. Every tool link is a unique invite link, so each wallet that takes a security action is counted and verified.

sections.why:
Builders keep shipping tools that stop attacks: approval revokers, wallets that check signatures and transactions. A tool only protects the users who find it, and users have no single place to learn what exists. They scramble to search X, GitHub and Reddit.

Wallet drainers took $494 million from 332,000 addresses in 2024 and $83.85 million from 106,106 wallets in 2025 (Scam Sniffer annual reports, drops.scamsniffer.io). Users who revoke bad approvals, check signatures and verify addresses avoid these attacks.
sections.in_scope:
- ETH Daily becomes a dedicated Ethereum security publication for the grant period
- A public hub of security tools and guides on token approvals, wallet signatures and address poisoning
- A unique, trackable invite link for each listed tool
- Guides and podcast episodes that send the audience to the hub
- A published neutrality policy
sections.out_scope:
- Building security tools
- Onboarding tool teams: we bring users to teams that already exist
- Coverage of chains other than Ethereum
sections.team: ETH Daily (pseudonymous): solo producer of a daily Ethereum news podcast, newsletter and social feed for over 4 years. Track record: https://x.com/ethdaily
sections.why_grant: The distribution exists: 10,000 combined newsletter and podcast subscribers and 26,000 combined followers on X, Lens and Farcaster (https://ethdaily.io/ads). Four years of coverage and a security archive are public. Nobody else funds this scope, which is why the price is $2,900 a month.
sections.commitments:
- Guides published under CC BY 4.0
- Paid referrals and sponsored listings are disclosed inline and never change what we recommend
- The hub is maintained for 12 months after the last milestone at no further cost
- Pinned target: at least 100 verified wallets completing a security action

milestones.name: Hub live
criteria: Hub live on ethdaily.io listing at least 8 tools and guides, checked by the technical reviewer
Neutrality policy live at https://ethdaily.io/terms and linked from the hub
Unique invite link live for each listed tool

milestones.name: Verified security actions
criteria: At least 100 distinct wallets completed a security action through the tracking links (revoked an approval or activated a listed tool), with duplicates, staff and automated wallets excluded.
The count verified by the technical reviewer from the link logs
At least 2 outside tool teams confirm activations in writing, 1 of them a wallet from this list: Ambire, Rabby, MetaMask, Ledger, Trust Wallet

milestones.name: Sustainability
criteria: At least $1,500 of sponsorship or referral revenue, not counting grants, received from at least 2 outside projects, shown on a revenue note and verified by the technical reviewer
